bullets.text: Fractile's £100m Boost - **Fractile** expands UK operations, enhancing the AI hardware ecosystem with significant government support.
Spirent Partners with ESA - **Spirent** collaborates with the European Space Agency to enhance PNT resilience in the UK.
Starlink Dominates Satellite Internet - **Starlink** leads the satellite broadband market with over 9 million subscribers globally.
MWC26 Barcelona Approaches - Major tech leaders confirmed for **MWC26**, showcasing innovations in mobile and digital transformation.
BT Group Leadership Changes - **BT Group** announces executive shifts, with Katie Milligan set to lead **Openreach**.
AI in Non-Terrestrial Networks - AI could revolutionize handover management in **non-terrestrial networks**, enhancing connectivity.
AT&T Expands Fiber Network - **AT&T** acquires Lumen's fiber business, enhancing its reach to over 4 million locations.
Google Cloud Partners with Liberty Global - **Google Cloud** and **Liberty Global** sign a five-year deal for AI and network automation.
Ericsson Validates 5G Slicing - **Ericsson** confirms performance-based 5G slicing can enhance connectivity for mobile operators.
Network Digital Twins for Telecom - **Network Digital Twins** technology offers real-time insights for smarter telecom operations.
